name: dsh-whale-brain
description: 把小鲸鱼的经历养成两颗粒子大脑：私聊一个自我、群聊一个自我，概念从语料里自己长出来，越旧的记忆越往外发散、越远忘得越多，闲下来还会自己去上网想明白一个词。
author: moguxx

permissions.files: read-write within ~/.dsh and the bridge state dir
permissions.network: outbound to public feed/search endpoints and 127.0.0.1 bridge ports
permissions.commands: spawns the local Life-OS helper processes (8787/8790) and restarts them when they die
permissions.credentials: reads the local QQ bridge console token at runtime to send proactive messages; never stored in the package
